name: Mid Suffolk

housing: Mid Suffolk is a rural district with Stowmarket as its main town, the small towns of Needham Market and Eye, and more than a hundred villages. Most households own their homes, and private lets range from estate houses in Stowmarket to timber-framed and thatched cottages in the villages. New estates have grown along the A14 and around Stowmarket and Thurston, and many rural homes are off mains gas and drains.
checkinTips: Timber-framed and thatched cottages: photograph beams, uneven floors, low doorways, the thatch where visible and any wood burner and flue.
Rural homes off mains gas: photograph the oil tank, its gauge level and the boiler service label.
Homes on private drainage: record the septic tank or treatment plant and when it was last emptied.
Homes on clay soils: note cracks around doors, windows and in plaster that could come from ground movement.
New-build estates in Stowmarket and Thurston: record snagging marks, sealant and any cracks so they are noted before the tenancy.
tenantHelp: Tenants with disrepair or safety concerns can contact the Babergh and Mid Suffolk private sector housing team, which can inspect homes and take action against landlords.
